summary: Pure decision function mapping an integer argument to an AI iteration count of 5 or 7: returns 7 when a1 < 3, returns 5 when 3 <= a1 <= 5, and returns 7 when a1 > 5. No side effects, no callees, no fields. All four callers (AISettingsFileLoader, AISettingsFileResolver, LookUpVehicleConfigEntry, AddVehicleConfigEntryToLinkedList) use the result to discriminate qualifying vs race AI config entries: they compare it to 5 (or store it as the entry discriminator) to select the qualifying ('qual' file suffix / qualifying vehicle-config entry) instead of the race default.

local_names.a1: input mapped to an iteration count
local_names.result: returned iteration count (5 for middle range, 7 otherwise)

operations.description: When a1 is less than 3 the function returns 7 immediately.
Initialize the default result to 5, which is only kept for the middle range 3 <= a1 <= 5.
When a1 is greater than 5 the function returns 7, overriding the default of 5.

Returns 5 when a1 is in [3,5] and 7 otherwise; callers compare the result to 5 (AISettingsFileLoader, AISettingsFileResolver, LookUpVehicleConfigEntry) or store it as the vehicle-config entry discriminator (AddVehicleConfigEntryToLinkedList) to select qualifying vs race AI config entries.
